name: NH Collection Madrid Colón
description: NH Collection Madrid Colón, formerly known as NH Madrid Sanvy, is situated in Salamanca, one of Madrid's exclusive neighborhoods. Nearby, you can shop at luxury brands: Gucci, Rolex, Loewe and Armani. If you wish to taste Spain's gastronomy, head to the Platea gourmet food hall, managed by the city's Michelin-starred chefs. Madrid's museums and Retiro Park are close by and Recoletos station is reachable on foot providing links to the rest of the city. NH Collection Madrid Colón has quiet and spacious rooms equipped with free Wi-Fi. Some have a beautiful view of Plaza Colón and every room has a pillow menu. Our Guest Relations team can organize tickets and reservations during your stay. If you prefer to relax at the hotel, sunbathe on the 4th floor terrace, take a dip in the open-air pool and unwind with a drink at the poolside bar. NH Collection Madrid Colón offers an excellent daily breakfast. For lunch and dinner choose between our restaurant or bar – the Bar Colón or Sushi Bar 99 which offers fine Japanese cuisine. Accompany your meal with the perfect wine from our cellar or opt for a delightful cocktail. There are a gym and meeting rooms on-site.
